quite the contrary! we're building exactly what our customers are asking for, and/or what we believe they need and aren't getting from our competitors. many of those customers are in exacting, often high-stakes professions like finance, law, and clinical/institutional research; industries where the cost of a misalignment or hallucination is simply too high. they're happy to pay a premium for Perplexity because they value accuracy and trustworthiness above everything else, and Perplexity consistently wins on those benchmarks.

time machine was specifically built for customers who need to build predictive models and agents they can trust not to cheat, which is currently a big but underdiscussed problem in agent post-training. at the moment, most (but not all) of those customers are in finance. and from what we've heard so far, many of them are very excited about this release!

Perplexity isn't for everyone, but the people who love it *really* love it. the people who don't just probably aren't our customer... yet. 😉
